purpose: Teach: 難く/突い/自分勝手/思案/一昔/仕草/相次ぐ/注ぎ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの絵は、忘れ難く心に残るのよ
lines.en: Sho — my drawings have a way of staying with you, don't they?
lines.style: Warm, almost musing tone. Soft opening. Speaking as if sharing a small, private observation. Gentle downward cadence, like she's pleased by the thought.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絵筆で紙を軽く突いて遊んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I was just poking the paper with the brush to play around.
lines.style: Bright, slightly sheepish. Quick energy on the opening. Eager to explain himself, words tumbling out. The honesty of a child admitting what he was doing without shame.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描きで自分勝手にはダメよ、お友達と分け合おうね
lines.en: Sho — you can't just do art however you want. You need to share with your friends, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but firm. Not scolding. The steady tone of someone setting a boundary she cares about. Slight pause before 「share」 — giving him space to understand, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、どの色にしようか思案中だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I'm trying to decide which colour to use.
lines.style: Thoughtful, a little uncertain. Slow opening. The small voice of someone genuinely deliberating, not asking for help — just thinking out loud. Trailing-off at the end, lost in the choice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは一昔前の絵本を持ってるのよ
lines.en: Sho — I have some old picture books from way back. You might like them.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried. Opening with quiet confidence. Speaking as if offering something precious without making a fuss. Slight lean in — not pushing, just inviting.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絵を描く時の仕草、メイ姉さん似だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — the way I move when I'm drawing — you do it just like me.
lines.style: Proud and delighted. Soft surprise in the opening. The tone of someone noticing a beloved detail. Small, genuine smile in the voice. Not teasing — genuinely touched.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祭りの招待が相次ぐ季節ね
lines.en: Sho — it's festival season again. The invitations just keep coming.
lines.style: Observant, slightly bemused. Even pace, like she's noticing something passing by. Warm undertone — not complaining, just acknowledging a pattern. Subtle smile in the rhythm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、水彩絵の具に水を注ぎ過ぎちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis — oops, I poured too much water into the watercolours.
lines.style: Self-aware, wry but not bitter. Quick admission with a touch of dry humour. The rueful tone of someone who knows what she did and is slightly amused by her own mistake. Light and unbothered.
